reference: Set 2026-11-16 from production runs on Windows 10, RTX 2060 (ANGLE D3D11), Chromium, 1440x900, DPR 1. Times allow about one dropped frame of headroom over what was measured; counts are exact or near-exact. Re-measure with `pnpm perf --update` on other hardware. Draw calls and triangles are recorded without a budget: they follow the default map's content, which keeps growing; the frame-time and CPU budgets catch what that content costs.

load.readyMs.why: Landing page to a warmed-up world. Measured 1.2-1.6 s.

load.longTaskMs.why: Main-thread blocking while the world loads behind the landing page. Measured 57-205 ms.

load.warmUpOk.why: Warm-up rehearsed the entry without creating resources.

load.warmUpNewResources.why: Nothing is compiled or uploaded after warm-up.

entry.maxFrameMs.why: Worst frame of the entry (median of 3). Measured 16.8 ms; at most one dropped frame.

entry.p95FrameMs.why: The entry runs at the display rate. Measured 16.7-16.8 ms.

entry.longTasks.why: No task over 50 ms during the entry (median of 3). Measured 0.

entry.programsCompiled.why: Every shader was compiled during warm-up.

pan.p95FrameMs.why: Panning runs at the display rate. Measured 16.7-16.8 ms.

pan.engineCpuMeanMs.why: Engine update + render per frame. Measured 0.6-0.7 ms.

idle.framesIn2s.why: A still world draws nothing, the perf badge included.

hover.frames.why: 80 pointer moves across one object: a frame only when the hovered thing changes. Measured 2.

hover.picks.why: At most one pick per pointer move. Measured 80.

hover.uiUpdates.why: React updates only when the hovered thing changes. Measured 2.

panel.openMs.why: Click on an object to its content panel shown, first open of the session. Measured about 30 ms.

panel.maxFrameMs.why: First open: at most one dropped frame. Measured 16.7-33 ms after warming the panel shell during loading (was 50-133 ms).

dayNight.p95FrameMs.why: The theme switch in the world runs at the display rate: only light values change.

dayNight.maxFrameMs.why: At most one dropped frame while the page's colours and the world's light change together.

dayNight.longTasks.why: Nothing heavy runs during the switch.

dayNight.programsCompiled.why: Day and night are uniform values on the same shaders: nothing compiles.

dig4x.blocksDug.why: The scenario really digs (8 clicks). Measured 8.

dig4x.maxFrameMs.why: Digging with the CPU slowed 4x, one run, so noisy: measured 16.8-83 ms over many runs, with or without the map's models. A real regression (remeshing far more than the dug cell) shows as 200+ ms.

dig4x.programsCompiled.why: The outline and burst were compiled during warm-up.

portrait.afterReadyMs.why: The living portrait loads after a quiet 2 s once the world is ready. Set 2026-11-22 from runs with a 1 s wait (1250-1410 ms), plus the second added since; not yet re-measured.

portrait.longTaskMs.why: Main-thread blocking while the portrait loads (model, shaders). Measured 0-152 ms.
